passages.original: καὶ Φάσιν ἠδὲ Γαληνόν, ὃς οἰκία ναιετάασκε
passages.english: and Phasis and Galenus, who used to dwell in homes
passages.notes: A single line from Quintus of Smyrna's Posthomerica (Fall of Troy); the relative clause continues beyond the passage, so where Galenus dwelt is not given here. Phasis and Galenus are presumably minor warriors slain in battle; I could not identify them further.
